title: Hub root layout
responsibility: Provides the browser session and shared workspace styles around the current hosted page.

inputs.name: +layout.children
inputs.description: This required Svelte `Snippet` is the current route's page content passed into the root layout. The layout renders it once without arguments and does not supply fallback content.

outputs.name: +layout
outputs.description: This is the route's page content produced by rendering the required `children` snippet once. The layout adds no wrapper element; the component separately imports workspace, design, and hub styles and provides a browser session context.

outputs.name: ssr
outputs.description: This layout module exports `false` for SvelteKit's `ssr` setting. It tells SvelteKit to render hosted pages in the browser, where the signed-in session and bridge live.
